text:
Carol should prevail. The ad’s statement that the car was a 1964 Thunderbird was an express warranty by description under UCC § 2-313, and delivering a 1968 breaches it; an “as is” clause disclaims implied warranties of condition, not that express warranty. The picture theories are unsupported: the facts never say the photo was of a new, undriven car, and warranty liability does not turn on the seller’s negligence.
CONFIDENCE: 84
